role: CI gate: compares every numeric (whole or decimal) value in .ci/*.txt against a baseline git ref and fails when a ceiling rises, a min_* floor falls, or a numeric budget is deleted or stops being a number, unless a `budget-raise-ok:` commit trailer names the file.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; no cd (relies on being run from repo root). BASE_REF=$1; CI_DIR env default .ci; no CI dir -> exit 0; not a git repo -> exit 0. Baseline resolution: $1, else origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF, else $BUDGET_BASE_REF, else no_baseline. Null SHA or unresolvable ref -> no_baseline. allowed_changes = paths after `budget-raise-ok:` trailers in `git log BASE..HEAD`. Loop over budget_files (tree plus baseline): file absent at baseline -> skip (new budget); baseline value not a number -> collected in not_budgets (e.g. scoring_constants_hash.txt) and skipped; compared++; file deleted -> report_loosened '(deleted)'; current not a number -> report_loosened '(not a number)'; loosens -> report_loosened; tightened -> 'ratcheted'; equal -> nothing. Prints the not-compared list. Any violation -> exit 1, else 'clean. N budgets compared'. Wired: gates.yml (PR: origin/base; push: github.event.before, else HEAD~1; all with BUDGET_REQUIRE_BASELINE=1), ci.yml, Makefile budget-monotonicity (baseline HEAD).

flags.text: Header says values are compared 'against the merge base'; for PRs the baseline is `origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF` (the target branch tip), so a budget lowered on main after the branch point reports as a raise on the PR. Header also lists three min_* floors; there are five (min_coverage_views, min_science_register_entries also exist).

units.does: No usable baseline: if BUDGET_REQUIRE_BASELINE is non-empty prints the reason to stderr and exits 1; otherwise prints a skip message and exits 0.
Returns failure if no trailers were collected; otherwise succeeds when the file path exactly equals a path named in a `budget-raise-ok:` trailer (grep -Fxq).
Succeeds when the file's basename starts with min_ (a floor that may only rise).
Strips whitespace from the raw text; returns failure unless it matches ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ (whole or decimal); prints the number.
Succeeds when moving budget $1 from $2 (baseline) to $3 (current) loosens it: for a min_* floor current < previous, otherwise current > previous; compared with awk so decimals work.

branches.effect: floor: loosened when current < previous; else ceiling: loosened when current > previous

units.does: Records a loosening of $1 described by $2: prints 'ALLOWED ... (acknowledged)' when a budget-raise-ok trailer names the file, else appends to violations.

Lists every *.txt directly in CI_DIR in the working tree plus every *.txt under CI_DIR at BASE_REF (git ls-tree), leading './' stripped, sorted and de-duplicated, so a deleted budget is still visited.
